VARIANT 08 — NOSTROMO REV 3 — GLASS + GLOW LAYERED ON V07 (6 EDITORIAL + 6 ATMOSPHERIC MOVES)
Soft cyan/green Gaussian blur radiating from
text + lines. Display name has BIG halation
subtle purple lower-right. Adds depth without
outer halation bloom, shimmer band drifting
across screen. Reads as physical, not flat.
cyan, purple, green). Three depth layers,
brighter ones in front. Parallax suggestion.
Stronger radial vignette: mid bright, corners
dark. Inside the project monitor too. The
whole deck feels like glass, not paper.
Cyan + amber underline under the display name
with phosphor glow filter. Marks divisions
Six editorial moves from V07 (corner marker, project monitor, red WARN, off-axis name, italic-serif tagline, section divider)
PLUS six atmospheric layers: phosphor halation glow on all text (A), single soft aurora bloom (B), glass treatment on the
monitor + CTAs + brand mark (C), depth orbs at three layers (D), strong CRT curvature vignette (E), glowing rule lines (F).
Reads: cinematic, photographic, dimensional. NOT flat terminal cosplay. Less Trapper Keeper, more 1979 Nostromo CRT photo.
